name: Entropy-Guided Dynamic Token Routing
problem_addressed: Fixed token routing in MoE leads to uniform compute expenditure regardless of token difficulty.
prior_art_limitation: Standard Top-K MoE routes tokens independently of entropy or sequence complexity.
proposed_mechanism: Information-theoretic entropy calculation gates compute allocation dynamically.

name: Titans Memory-Augmented Recurrent Gating
problem_addressed: Standard Transformer attention degradation on long-context window sequences.
prior_art_limitation: KV cache memory grows linearly with sequence length.
proposed_mechanism: Persistent fast-decay neural memory gates long-horizon context features.

name: Mixture of Recursions (MoR)
problem_addressed: Parameter inflation in ultra-deep transformer stacks.
prior_art_limitation: Fixed depth per token regardless of reasoning difficulty.
proposed_mechanism: Dynamic recursive parameter sharing allocated per layer boundary.
